definitions.estimand: EQUAL_CLUSTER_MEAN_PAIRED_DIFFERENCE, strata pooled inside a cluster
definitions.false_association: M3 and M5 queries whose returned evidence includes a decoy or same-name-twin source
definitions.power: two-sided alpha 0.05, power 0.80, normal approximation, cluster SD
definitions.slot_recall: complete evidence set among gold SUPPORTED queries, failures count zero
definitions.status: reported separately; on the chain families the interpreter clears the requested fields, so status is unchanged by the evidence by construction
definitions.unequal_control: the oracle topology is an upper bound, never an arm of the contrast family
definitions.useful_extra: gold slots a graph arm covers that G0 does not, per 1,000 visited nodes

label: DEVELOPMENT_PILOT_ROLE; NOT_A_CONFIRMATORY_RESULT; NOT_A_BENEFIT_CLAIM
limits: Pilot role only (24 clusters, 20 primary), synthetic template and NOISY_V1 renderings, untuned owner-set walk defaults, no tune or evaluation role read, no G5, G6 or G7, no benefit claim; CPU serial; seeds are the conventional channels.

wall_cap.basis: 1.5 x (16.94 s per query measured on the 24-query smoke run p06-t21-smoke-001 x 192 queries = 3,253 s); stop and ask above 8 h

privacy.scope: private M4 sources are never published to the runtime store; the denied-bridge walk control is tests/test_diffusion_privacy.py
